'''September 2001 Detroit tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at RIW Hobbies, Detroit, Michigan on 28 September 2001. It is known from Chris O'Hara's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3007">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-01-riw-hobbies-detroit-9-28-01d3007/ riw-hobbies-detroit-9-28-01], DeckTech (Chris "crzybkhd" O'Hara, 1 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-01-riw-hobbies-detroit-9-28-01d3007/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 28 September 2001
* '''Site:''' RIW Hobbies, Detroit, Michigan
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 36
